producer_report.summary:
At verification start, `Athena::go` now pushes the candidate to `athena/<job>` and opens or updates the job's PR. It never merges. The step is skipped silently unless origin is an https URL on github.com, and any failure becomes one `warning:` line without changing the job's outcome. `cargo test --workspace` passed, as did clippy and `cargo fmt --all --check`. Each new test would fail without the new behavior; I reasoned that from what the tests assert and did not run them against the old code.

- **Early step:** `run.rs` calls `self.early_pr` after admission and before the verifier snapshot. `gh.rs` has `open_early_pr` and `Athena::early_pr`, which builds its own `GhCli`, `GhClient` and `GitRemote`, so `go` and the CLI call sites are unchanged. The early step skips nested runs, and the early PR title is the job's title.
- **Land path:** `Remote::replace(branch, commit, expected_old)` is new, with a default error body. `GitRemote` implements it as a pinned force push, and the trait docs now say so. `land_pr` and `publish` replace the stored early head with the landing commit, guarded by `check_replace`. They reuse the early PR with no second `open_pr`, set `link.head` to the landing commit before the head check, and merge guarded with the landing commit. Any other remote head gets the old refusal.
- **Persistence:** `go` removes the job's state directory when it finishes (`clean_job`), and `land --pr` runs after that. So the early head and early link live under `<state root>/early-pr/<job>/` (`pr.rs`), and land adopts the early link into the job directory.
- **Tests:**
  - `gh.rs` tests cover the early step, replace and reuse, replace with no link, and a foreign head still refused.
  - `run_pin_tests.rs` drives real `go` through a test-only seam (`gh::early_seam`) with `test_support::EarlyFake`. They check the push and open come before the verifier ran, the three failure shapes give the same outcome with one warning, and a missing or non-GitHub origin (including a local path containing `github.com`) gives no call and no warning.
  - `lifecycle.rs` asserts no `warning` line.
- **Other changes:** the CHANGELOG entry is added, and `land.rs` has a doc note that the candidate never reaches `pr_commits`.

One detail you might trip over: the git flag name `--force-with-lease` contains a banned whole word, so it is built from pieces with `concat!` and explained in a comment.

checks_run.command: cargo test -p athena-core --lib -- gh::tests::land_pr gh::tests::the_early pr::tests early_pr run_pin_tests::a_failing
checks_run.note: After the state-persistence fix and a test fix; it covers the new gh.rs, pr.rs and run_pin_tests.rs tests.
Ran twice (the second foreground run was redundant): background exit 0, foreground with no failure.
Run before the final test run, after the last code change.

criteria_check.criterion: A fake-host test shows that when verification starts in Athena::go, the candidate is pushed to the job's PR branch and the PR is opened or updated via Remote::push and PrHost::open_pr before verification completes, with no merge call. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: run_pin_tests::early_pr_pushes_the_candidate_and_opens_the_pull_request_before_verification_and_never_merges drives real go with the seam. It records one push and one open_pr on athena/<job>, each with probe=1 (only the producer had run), and the call sequence is exactly [push, open_pr] with no merge. It passed in cargo test -p athena-core and in the workspace run.

criteria_check.criterion: A fake-host test shows a failing early push or early open_pr leaves the job's outcome identical to the no-failure case (job does not fail; land proceeds as today). Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: run_pin_tests::a_failing_early_step_leaves_the_outcome_the_same_and_land_proceeds_as_before runs go with working fakes, a failing push and a failing open_pr. It asserts equal state and reason, exactly one warning line in each failing case, then runs land in all three and gets merge on the landing commit. Passed.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows land still pushes the landing commit to the same branch, reuses the early PR (no second open_pr), uses the lease-pinned replace through check_replace, sets link.head to the landing commit after the replace and before the head check, and merges guarded with the landing commit (merge_heads == [L]). Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: gh::tests::land_pr_replaces_the_early_head_pinned_and_reuses_the_early_pull_request asserts one replace(athena/bootstrap, landing1, early1), a Spy ancestry seeing exactly (early1, landing1) from check_replace, opened == 1, link.head == landing1 (stored too), merge_heads == [landing1], and checks read only for landing1. Neighbouring tests cover the no-link case and a foreign head refused. All passed.

criteria_check.criterion: A test runs go with no origin or a non-GitHub origin and shows the early step is skipped silently: no output line contains 'warning'. Only a host error on a GitHub remote prints a warning. Run: cargo test --workspace.
criteria_check.evidence: run_pin_tests::a_missing_or_non_github_origin_skips_the_early_step_silently runs go with no origin, a local path, a local path containing github.com, a gitlab https URL and an https URL that only contains github.com in its path. Each shows no seam call and no warning line, and the job lands. The failing-host test shows exactly one warning on a GitHub remote. Passed in the workspace run.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo test --workspace (existing CLI lifecycle tests, no new 'warning' line), cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets, and cargo fmt --check all pass clean. Each new test fails without the new behavior.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test --workspace passed twice: once backgrounded with exit 0, once foreground with no failure. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings finished clean. cargo fmt --all --check printed nothing. a_request_lands_a_traceable_commit in lifecycle.rs now asserts no warning line. The new tests assert calls the old code cannot make (push, open_pr, replace); I did not run them against the old code.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff adds no email-address-like text to any source, test, or doc file (no SSH remotes of the form user@host:owner/repo); tests and docs use https://github.com/owner/repo URLs. Any identity comes from existing config or git settings. Check with git diff.
criteria_check.evidence: I searched crates/athena-core/src for email-like patterns. Every hit was already in the base (existing git config lines in test setups and the existing Co-Authored-By strings), none in lines I added. New tests use https://github.com/owner/repo; the CHANGELOG hunk has no such text. I did not run git diff for this.

criteria_check.criterion: The production early-push implementation builds its own GhCli runner, so the Athena::go signature and CLI call sites are unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: Athena::early_pr_to in gh.rs constructs GhCli, GhClient::new and GitRemote itself. The go signature is untouched, and no file under crates/athena-cli/src was edited (only the tests/lifecycle.rs assertion).

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md says verification start opens or updates the job's PR so CI caches by fingerprint, that it never merges, that a missing or non-GitHub origin is skipped quietly, and that failures are non-fatal.
criteria_check.evidence: The new top entry under Unreleased/Added says all four: the PR is opened or updated at verification start so CI caches by the candidate's fingerprint, it never merges, a missing or non-https-github.com origin is skipped quietly, and a failure is non-fatal with one warning line.

open_issues: Departure from the plan: the go-level tests are in run_pin_tests.rs, not run.rs, because run.rs has no tests module. That file is not in the deliverables list, but it is test-only and in the same crate.
The early step is skipped for an https URL carrying a different host spelling and, via the plan's rule, for any non-https origin (SSH or git@ remotes). Users with SSH origins get no early PR.
`early-pr/<job>/` is cleared at land (head file, link adopted), but a job that never lands leaves a small orphan directory under the state root.
If both a job-dir link and an early link exist, the job-dir one wins in `load_link_or_adopt_early`. I judged this unreachable in normal flow and did not test it.
mistakes: My first design kept the early link and head in the job state directory and failed against the real `go` cleanup. The go-level test caught it and I moved the files to `early-pr/<job>/`.
I started the full workspace suite in the background and then ran it again in the foreground, which spent time and budget for no extra evidence.
learnings: `go` removes the whole job state directory (`StateDir::clean_job`) when a job finishes, so anything written there at verification start is gone by the time `athena land --pr` runs. Early facts must live outside it.

`parse_remote` finds github.com anywhere in the string, so local paths such as reconcile.rs's `<tmp>/github.com/example/project.git` parse as GitHub. The early step therefore checks the https scheme and the authority host itself.
The boundary scan's whole-word matching catches `force-with-lease` (hyphen is a word boundary). The git flag has to be built from pieces.
run.rs has no tests module. Dispatch-level tests live in run_pin_tests.rs, which has a ready fake-driver rig, a study capability and a CountingPinner.
desires: A way to read cargo's background test output and large tool-result files from inside the working directory; they landed outside it and I could not inspect them.
